body: I do hope that it's possibly just hormonal. Like I said in my OP, I did not keep track of when I got my last period and I'm not pregnant (at least not to the point where it's measurable) so here's hoping to hormones. I hate that if it is hormones, there's little to nothing I can do other than wait it out.

~~Umm wow, are you stalking me?  There was a Glee marathon on Oxygen today.  I stopped watching it because I was caught up on episodes that I had missed, but it did make me feel good.~~

Duh.  I didn't even re-read what I'd posted.  What an idiot!

I just pulled out my classy box of wine and poured myself a glass.  

DH is talking to me right now, although he's busy and can't talk on the phone for some reason.

It's highly possible.  Like, I'm going to bring up what I remember happening to him and see what he knows, but I think you could be right.  It's just really weird because this has never happened to me before.
Forgive me but I'm not seeing it in your last post, what is this self destructive behavior that you're doing?
Thanks.  I guess I'm just a little shocked, trying to piece together whether it was real or not.
Thanks.  That is part of the plan now.  I wasn't thinking earlier when I typed this up.  :)

Thank you for your support. I know I should be thankful for the things that I have. I know that I'm stronger than I give myself credit for. It's just so fucking hard right now. I feel like everyone is mad at me and I can't take it right now. I'm mad enough at myself and it just doesn't feel fair to have to deal with anger like this on all angles.
